mapper.select: select card_cd, sort_no, hidden_yn from sys_home_user_card where user_id = #{userId} order by sort_no, card_cd
mapper.insert:
insert into sys_home_user_card (comp_cd, user_id, card_cd, sort_no, hidden_yn, created_by, updated_by) values
(hb_current_comp(), #{userId}, #{r.cardCd}, #{r.sortNo}, #{r.hiddenYn}, #{by}, #{by})
mapper.select: select gc.card_cd, gc.sort_no, gc.hidden_yn from sys_home_grp_card gc where gc.auth_grp_cd = ( select g.auth_grp_cd from sys_user_auth ua join sys_auth_group g on g.comp_cd = ua.comp_cd and g.auth_grp_cd = ua.auth_grp_cd and g.use_yn = 'Y' where ua.user_id = #{userId} and exists (select 1 from sys_home_grp_card x where x.comp_cd = g.comp_cd and x.auth_grp_cd = g.auth_grp_cd) order by g.sort_no, g.auth_grp_cd limit 1) order by gc.sort_no, gc.card_cd

select g.auth_grp_cd, g.auth_grp_nm, g.sort_no, g.admin_yn, g.use_yn, (select count(*) from sys_home_grp_card gc where gc.comp_cd = g.comp_cd and gc.auth_grp_cd = g.auth_grp_cd)::int as card_cnt from sys_auth_group g order by g.sort_no, g.auth_grp_cd

select g.auth_grp_cd, g.auth_grp_nm, g.sort_no, g.admin_yn, g.use_yn, (select count(*) from sys_home_grp_card gc where gc.comp_cd = g.comp_cd and gc.auth_grp_cd = g.auth_grp_cd)::int as card_cnt from sys_auth_group g where g.auth_grp_cd = #{authGrpCd}
select card_cd, sort_no, hidden_yn from sys_home_grp_card where auth_grp_cd = #{authGrpCd} order by sort_no, card_cd

select ap.prog_cd from sys_auth_prog ap join sys_prog p on p.prog_cd = ap.prog_cd and p.use_yn = 'Y' where ap.auth_grp_cd = #{authGrpCd} and ap.action_cd = 'SEARCH' union -- 개인 화면(self_service_yn = 'Y', 결재함 등)은 로그인 사용자 모두 조회 권한(AuthMapper 와 같은 규칙) — 5단계 결재 카드. -- 권한 그룹 단위 질의라 사용자 유형 조건이 필요 없다: 협력사 포털 사용자는 권한 그룹에 들 수 없다(docs/42 2장 트리거) select p.prog_cd from sys_prog p where p.use_yn = 'Y' and p.self_service_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert:
insert into sys_home_grp_card (comp_cd, auth_grp_cd, card_cd, sort_no, hidden_yn, created_by, updated_by) values
(hb_current_comp(), #{authGrpCd}, #{r.cardCd}, #{r.sortNo}, #{r.hiddenYn}, #{by}, #{by})
mapper.select: select plant_cd, plant_nm from sys_plant where use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, plant_cd
select plant_cd, plant_nm from sys_plant where plant_cd = #{plantCd} and use_yn = 'Y'
